, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the number of valence electrons for Selenium. Selenium (Se) is in Group 16 (the chalcogens) of the periodic table. Elements in Group 16 have 6 valence electrons, not 5. The Planner confused Group 16 with Group 15 (which has 5 valence electrons), leading to the wrong conclusion that the answer is B) 5 instead of the correct C) 6.
